description: Local-first Ownly evidence and repeatable Planner visits with preview-before-commit writes.
name: io.github.liuh886/ownly

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a parent containing Ownly/ or directly to a custom Ownly data root containing Objects/.
environmentVariables.name: OWNLY_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable two-phase persistent write commits. Omit for read-only mode.
environmentVariables.name: OWNLY_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: OpenRouteService API key used by local Planner travel-leg refresh and travel-time optimization for walking/driving/bicycling.
environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTESERVICE_API_KEY

title: Ownly
